## Problem statement

What user or developer problem does this solve?

## Proposed API or behavior

Describe the proposed component, prop, controller, or behavior.

## Accessibility & privacy impact

- How does this affect keyboard navigation, focus management, screen-reader semantics, or reduced motion?
- Does it require any network access or external data? (Core display preferences must remain local and privacy-safe.)

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you have considered.
